data.narrative:
Axibo AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing startup founded by Anoop Gadhrri, Sohaib Al-Emara, and Reiner Schmidt, having raised C$12M to date. The robotics sector comprises a comp universe of 9 private companies and 1 public entity (277810.KQ), including peers such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method is reliably applicable. Using total capital raised as a proxy base value of $12M and applying a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier for progression from Seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $30M. A formal peer-median approach cannot be applied; while 10 robotics peers exist, the filtered set for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables contains insufficient observations (fewer than 3) to support meaningful triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M, centered on a $30M median. This range reflects uncertainty around stage-progression multiplier applicability in a capital-efficient robotics market, and the absence of direct peer-based validation. Key risks include the limited peer set depth in narrow stage/tier bands and reliance on a single methodological pillar. Additional data on comparable Seed-to-Series A step-ups within frontier robotics would strengthen conviction in the derived range.
